title: Implement explicit V2 ledger initialization, binding and rebind

checkpoint.summary: Explicit V2 initialization/bind/rebind/health existed. Now serialized all local binding/head advancement under a checkout-specific cross-process lock, made persisted head updates atomic/private and non-regressing, and required both prior stored trust and new caller anchor on remote rebind. Read-only health reports bare Git non-fast-forward/deletion protection accurately and hosted visibility/signing policy as Unknown. Reject credential-bearing remote URLs. Disposable tests cover concurrent readers, divergent roots, changed push URL, missing/ref-restored ledger and source-worktree preservation.
checkpoint.nextAction: Finish provider-specific visibility and branch protection verification and signed-commit requirements with explicit fail-closed setup; separately implement audited restore/rebind epoch integration under V2-13. Keep V2-01 active until these acceptance criteria are verified.
verified: V2 setup/health typed MCP and OAuth catalog tests
Two-clone bind, trust-head persistence, changed URL, explicit privacy consent and rebind fixtures
Six simultaneous readers serialize behind binding file lock; persisted highestTrustedHead advances monotonically with 0600 permissions
Rebind rejects independent same-UUID history even when caller provides an anchor from the other root
Health reports enforced/not-configured bare Git non-fast-forward and deletion policy, while marking visibility and signing unknown
Embedded HTTP/SSH URL credentials rejected before config write
Changed approved push URL and deleted remote ledger ref rejected without losing configured anchor; restoring exact head succeeds
